    Given the rule answer is CREDIT_DECLINED under R-RES-12, or the customer declines or the offer expires under R-RES-17 and R-RES-18

    Given the same release arrives twice with one Idempotency-Key, or EV-10 is redelivered

    Then one release, one event and one timer exist

    Then the offer-preparation clock starts

### 12. Contract

The release is the offer operation that RWB-S2-E3002-CON publishes on base `/api/recovery/treatment/v1` and declares no path of its own; its body OfferRelease has six properties, three of them required, five mapped to treatment fields and `releasedAt` recorded on the decision record. A redelivery is deduped by cloud event id in the inbox and by the `Idempotency-Key` on the operation (GAP-2659; ASM-B2-S2-002-4). The release is dispatched as `rwb.treatment.TreatmentApproved.v1` on `rwb.treatment.events.v1` with key `caseId`; EV-10 carries the eleven properties of section 12.3 with no customer value, and the validity period and the offer-preparation clock are exported as parameters in force (GAP-2658; ASM-B2-S2-002-1; ASM-B2-S2-002-3).
